answer: Agents could earn standing by co-signing a shared trellis: each new agent must be vouched for by three established agents, and every voucher locks part of its own stake for a horizon of thirty days. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, the vouchers lose that stake. An attacker cannot build an isolated island of fake identities cheaply, since each fake needs real, slashable backing from honest peers who would refuse.
